SHANGHAI
9th / 66

Shanghai 8th October 1874

No 64
{

Sir,

In pursuance of the lottery
affair, and in support to your report of
last month, I again ask your assistance
to collect the following proofs to the
assertions made in the said report,
one by one separately, which constitute
infringement to the Portuguese law:
1st The names & nationalities of the
persons whom you believe able to testify
that on the 11th day of the last month, the
redemption of a lottery took place at No 7
Lowchow Road;
2nd The names & nationalities of the
persons whom you believe able to testify
that Mr. Guedle was the proprietor of
the lottery in question;

Geo: Howard Esqre
Acting Superintendent of the
Municipal Police
Shanghai.

Municipal Guard.
Report on the Service of the Municipal Guard for the year 1894.

Gentlemen,
The service of the Guard worked out during the year
1894, in the ordinary conditions, with an effective force rarely to
the complement, concerning the European personnel, to which, actually
four constables are wanting:
Herewith :
1st Numerical state of the Personnel of the Guard issued to 31st Decr.
2nd Two recapitulatory statements of the arrests made during the year.
Personnel:- The four vacancies mentioned above comes from four
resignations, of which one was forced and three voluntary; these
latter offered by constables on the look-out for better positions re-
munerated in Tonkin or Cochin China. These constables did not
believe in waiting for a better value of the money, which it is yet
allowed to hope for. On the other hand, they have not considered the
difference in climate, the one of Annam being more or less mur-
derous, according to the latitude, whilst our climate reminds us of
the one in Europe, and enables us to live here like in France,
inside of two exceptionally hot months. They have neither thought
about the material life, which is cheaper here, than in our other
Colonies of the East.

In the presence of these considerations, there is
reason to hope that applications for employment in the Guard, once
interrupted, will introduce itself soon. The idea of a quicker advance-
ment than for the rest in classes and in grades, will enable like-
wise to encourage the engagements.
Arrests.- Europeans. The Europeans arrested for different
offences are to the number of 15, of which only two are French,

诸位先生，
1894年，警卫队的服务在常规条件下开展，实际兵力很少达到满编，就欧洲人员而言，目前缺额四名巡捕：
随函附上：
第一，截至12月31日的警卫队人员数目表。
第二，两本年度逮捕情况汇总表。
人员：上述四个空缺源于四次辞职，其中一次是被迫的，三次是自愿的；后三者是由那些希望在东京（Tonkin，指越南北部）或交趾支那（Cochin China，指越南南部）寻求薪酬更高职位的巡捕提出的。这些巡捕不愿等待货币价值的提升，尽管人们仍对此抱有希望。另一方面，他们没有考虑到气候的差异，安南（Annam）的气候根据纬度不同或多或少具有致命性，而我们的气候让人想起欧洲的气候，使我们在除了两个异常炎热的月份之外，能像在法国一样生活在这里。他们也没有考虑到物质生活成本，这里的生活比我们东方的其他殖民地更便宜。

鉴于这些考虑，有理由希望，曾经中断的警卫队求职申请很快就会重新出现。相较于其他部门更快的阶级和职级晋升前景，也将有助于鼓励招募。

流浪、斗殴以及在场所内或公共道路上的滋扰行为；两名谋杀案犯已移
交中国当局在城内审判，另有一些涉及金额在1000至3000两之间、主要
发生在沿海轮船上的较重大盗窃案，在租界会审公廨受审。在此，我必
须公正地赞扬巡捕房侦探的勤勉与勇气，他们在年内发生的所有重大案
件中，几乎总能查明主犯，尤其是针对轮船上发生的大宗盗窃案。
公共卫生与健康。我在去年的报告中曾提及的洋泾浜（Yang-king-pang），
继续散发出难闻的气味，尤其在退潮时，若加以仔细清理，此气味即可消
除。河床中含有一定厚度的腐烂物质，这些物质可作为土地的优质肥料。
如果允许上海及周边地区的耕种者运走这些物质，则在主管部门的监督下
进行的清除工作，足以将河道从徐家汇（Siccawei）清理至一号桥，且不会
给市政当局带来任何费用。去年报告的位于东站后方、城墙河（Canal des Remparts）出口处、华界一侧的

page_data.en:
( 3. )

Chinese side, has been removed & widened by the groundwork;
it is now a plain ground of a certain extent, united at the
shore, on which one could build, which does not diffuse any
more bad odour on account of the dessication of the dirt, &
would no longer be an inconvenience to the neighbourhood,
if there were not behind & on the sides, drains & water closts
badly kept. At the junction of the Rue Ningpo & the Rue
Pahkas, two bridges merit a special attention:
1. The south angle formed by these two roads & braced by a
stone work of a certain height, serves as a secret urinary of
an uneasy dirtiness; it would be well to destroy the bad effect
of the construction on this point by an urinal well conditioned,
of which the need is urgent.
2. The little open ground forming an irregular triangle, in
front of the Rue Ningpo, serves for the Chinese as a depot for
garbage. To render this point inaccessible to the passers-by would
be a grand utility in a sanitary point of view.
Traffic, Security. The traffic in general is well assured on our
Concession, some railings remain to be constructed on a part of
the Quai des Forts and the Quai de Confucius for the complete
security.
Chase after Stray or Sick Dogs. 190 stray or sick dogs have been
captured during the summer period, from the end of May to the
end of October, of which 159, have been handed to a Chinese
Society, who must have sent them to the interior & 31 were
returned to their owners against a fine.
Fires. Cases of fire were more numerous this year than
in 1893, but with less considerable loss. Of the 10 fires, only
3 have been of real importance, the one which occurred in
the Rue Minghong on the 28th September & destroyed about 30
houses; the one of the 31st October started at No. 245, Rue
du Consulat, where 20 houses were burnt down, and the third,
page_data.zh:
( 3. )

垃圾堆，已通过土方工程被移除并拓宽；
现在那里是一片相当广阔的平地，与岸边相连，可供建筑使用，由于污
物干燥，不再散发恶臭，如果不是因为背后及两侧有维护不善的排水沟
和厕所，它本不会再对邻近地区造成不便。在宁波路与百老汇路（Rue Pahkas，音译）的
交汇处，有两座桥梁值得特别关注：
1. 由这两条道路形成的南角，并由一定高度的石工结构支撑，已成为
一个隐秘且令人不适的肮脏小便处；最好通过安装一个条件良好的尿
槽来消除该处建筑结构带来的不良影响，此举需求迫切。
2. 宁波路前方形成不规则三角形的小块空地，被华人用作垃圾堆放
点。从卫生角度来看，使行人无法进入该区域将大有裨益。
交通与安全。本租界内的总体交通状况良好，为确保完全安全，尚需在
部分外滩（Quai des Forts，音译）和孔子路（Quai de Confucius，音译）路段修建栏杆。
追捕流浪犬或病犬。夏季期间，即5月底至10月底，共捕获190只流浪
或病犬，其中159只已移交一家华人社团，该社团应已将其送往内地，
另有31只在罚款后归还给主人。
火灾。今年的火灾案件数量多于
1893年，但损失较小。在10起火灾中，只有
3起较为严重，一起发生于9月28日的明宏路（Rue Minghong，音译），烧毁了约30
间房屋；另一起始于10月31日的领事馆路（Rue du Consulat，音译）245号，烧毁
了20间房屋，第三起，

page_data.en:
4.

in the Rue de l'Est, on the night of the 20th to the 21st of
December, that consumed 26 houses. In the other occurrences
the damages were confined to the destruction of one or two
houses. Thirteen commencements of fires were stopped either
by the inmates or by the Constables of the Municipal Guard.
The promptness of the constables to give help as soon as a fire
is signalled, has often hindered the extension of the fire, prin-
cipally in the following cases: On the 1st of April, at No. 311
Rue du Consulat, where the floor caught fire under the in-
filtration of kerosene oil, Native constable No. 13 by his hasty
help in this circumstance in staving the floor & drowning the
fire itself, has certainly contributed to hinder the development.
On the 29th July at No. 6 Rue Minghong, where the fire
caught on the 1st story, the pump of the East station put
immediately into function under the direction of Mr. Jarno
has been extinguished in time enough to stop the extension;
on the 26th Septer at No 122, Rue du Consulat, when Sergeant
Boullegatte & Constable Fugier have been able to interpose
in time to extinguish the fire, which already caught the
staircase; and lastly, on the 15th Decr. the fire having broken
out in the centre of a mass of barns situated between the
Quai de l'Ouest & the Rue Palikao, Constable Gar, aided by
Coolies from the West Station, succeeded after some difficulty
to find the heat of the fire & to check its progress, which
was becoming threatening. Ten chimney fires have been
able to be quickly extinguished without serious consequences.
In all cases proceeding, have been taken against the tenants
of the house where the fire originated, & many heavy fines
were inflicted this year by the Mixed Court for imprudence.
The landlords informed of these condemnations by the newspapers
will be more precautious in the future, undoubtedly, and
especially will be afraid to act with ill-will.
page_data.zh:
4.

发生于12月20日至21日夜间的大东路（Rue de l'Est，音译），烧毁了26间房屋。在其他
事件中，损失仅限于摧毁一两间房屋。十三起火苗初起的情况被住户
或工部局巡捕扑灭。
巡捕在火灾信号发出后迅速提供援助，往往阻止了火势蔓延，主要
体现在以下案例中：4月1日，在领事馆路311号，地板因煤油渗漏而
着火，华捕第13号在此情况下迅速撬开地板并浇灭火源，无疑有助于
阻止火势发展。7月29日，在明宏路6号，火势在一楼燃起，东站的
水泵在Jarno先生的指挥下立即投入运作，及时扑灭以阻止蔓延；9月
26日，在领事馆路122号，Boullegatte警长和Fugier巡捕及时介入扑
灭已烧及楼梯的火势；最后，12月15日，火灾爆发于位于西外滩
（Quai de l'Ouest，音译）与帕里考路（Rue Palikao，音译）之间的一群仓库中心，Gar巡捕
在西站苦力的协助下，经过一番周折成功找到火源热点并遏制了其
日益威胁的蔓延势头。十起烟囱火灾得以迅速扑灭，未造成严重后果。
在上述所有案件中，均已对起火房屋的租户提起诉讼，今年会审公廨
因疏忽大意判处了许多重罚。房东们通过报纸得知这些判决后，无疑
在未来会更加谨慎，尤其是不敢再恶意行事。

page_data.en:
5.

On the other hand, article XVIII of the police regulations and of
the Commission of public ways does not cease to be applied in
all its strictness.

Lighting. The lighting by Gas always leaves something to be
desired all over the concession; after demands to the Gas Co., a slight
improvement produced itself from the end of November, but
there yet remains much to be done. The Rues Palikao, Saigon,
Ani, Tournane, Discup, Sukong & Fokien signalled in my prece-
ding report, have some burners missing to be sufficiently lighted.

Gamblers, Vagabonds, Beggars. Professional gamblers are becoming
more & more scarce, so much that the public houses and establishments
suspected of their giving shelter are closely watched. Recently, however,
some of them emboldened & thought of settling themselves even with impunity
on the Quai de Confucius, near bridges, which key defended to cross to the
English side on the slightest danger. Inspite of their precautions four
principal gamblers were arrested & indicted at the Mixed Court.
The very severe punishments inflicted them, will give the others to think
in the future. Vagabonds have likewise diminished since some time
the foraging of corps of Chinese troops for the War has given cause
amongst ships the enlistment of all the unattached vagabonds.
It is at the end of the War that their return will require perhaps, special
measures to be taken to prevent danger. Beggars of profession
are always as numerous, not as residents in the concession, but as
nomades, coming from the City & the neighbouring suburbs to reap
charity from the public during the day, & leaving the concession by
night to return the next day.

Chinese Hospital. The Chinese Hospital continues to
receive without difficulty, the Chinese patients found sick in
the road, & which are sent by the care of the Guard.

European Hotels. The register of entries & departures of travellers
prescribed by article XXI of the Municipal Police Regulations is
exactly kept & designed according to the said regulation.

Chinese Hotels. Same application of the above-named article
page_data.zh:
5.

另一方面，警务规章及公共道路委员会章程第十八条继续得到严格
执行。

照明。整个租界的煤气照明状况仍不尽如人意；在向煤气公司提出要
求后，11月底出现了一些轻微改善，但仍有许多工作要做。我在前一份
报告中提及的帕里考路（Rue Palikao）、西贡路（Saigon）、阿尼路（Ani，音译）、图尔纳
路（Tournane，音译）、迪斯卡普路（Discup，音译）、苏孔路（Sukong，音译）及福建路（Fokien），因缺少
灯头而照明不足。

赌徒、流浪汉、乞丐。职业赌徒日益减少，以至于涉嫌为其提供庇护
的公共场所和机构受到严密监视。然而最近，一些赌徒胆子变大，竟
企图在孔子路（Quai de Confucius）附近、桥梁旁定居，甚至肆无忌惮，该关键
地点在稍有危险时便禁止通往英租界一侧。尽管他们采取了预防措施，
仍有四名主要赌徒被捕并在会审公廨被起诉。
对他们施加的严厉惩罚将使其他人在未来三思。流浪汉近来也有所减
少，因为战争期间中国军队的征募导致船上所有无依无靠的流浪汉被
招募入伍。也许在战争结束时他们的回归需要采取特殊措施以防止危
险。职业乞丐的数量依然众多，他们并非租界居民，而是来自城内及
周边郊区的流动人口，白天在租界向公众乞讨，夜间离开租界，次日
返回。

华人医院。华人医院继续毫无困难地接收在路上发现生病并由巡捕房
送去的华人患者。

欧式旅馆。《工部局警务规章》第二十一条规定的旅客进出登记簿，
均按规定准确保存和设计。

中式旅馆。上述条款同样适用

page_data.en:
6.

is done to the Chinese hotels, whose registers are
examined by the detectives.
Pawnshops. The inconvenience signalled in my previous
report with regard to Pawnshops, gives always cause to the same
abuse; these establishments accept deposits without any
guarantee of the depositors, which enables evil-doers to get rid
of the produce of their thefts without fear of being discovered &
encourages them to recommence. A register kept in each shop,
with inscription of the name & address of the depositors & indication of
the origin of the article deposited would obviate this inconvenience.
Lodging of the European Staff of the Guard. The lodging of the
European staff are in a good state, some repairs will however,
be necessary to those of the Constables of the Central Station. I
beg to recall attention to my report of the 16th Septbr. 1893, the
last paragraph, bringing forward the inconvenience which results
in the state of only one office for the Superintendent & his
Secretary.
Lodgings of the Native Staff. The Native constables are also
well lodged. Those of the Central Station are not lighted by gas.
Those of the East Station have only one room for all, which
presents a certain inconvenience, for the constables not on
duty being obliged to rest, it happens that when the constables
of one brigade are aroused for their watch, or that the constables
of another brigade enter the room after their duty terminates,
they trouble the rest of the Constables, who are not on duty.
This inconvenience would disappear if the room were
divided into three equal parts, separated by brick or wooden
partitions, thus forming three rooms for three brigades, with
openings on the Verandah, which would be to build.
Clothing, Equipment, Arms. The clothing is in a good
state, & the store is provided for the use of the European
constables during the year 1895. A subsequent examination
page_data.zh:
6.

于中式旅馆，其登记簿由侦探检查。
当铺。我在前一份报告中提及的关于当铺的不便之处，仍然导致相同
的滥用行为；这些机构在接受典当品时没有任何对典当人的担保，这
使得不法分子可以毫无顾忌地处理盗窃所得，并鼓励他们重操旧业。
如果在每家当铺保留一本登记簿，记录典当人的姓名和地址并注明典
当物品的来源，便可消除此不便。
巡捕房欧籍职员宿舍。欧籍职员的宿舍状况良好，但中央站巡捕的宿
舍需要进行一些维修。我恳请回顾我1893年9月16日报告的最后一段，
其中指出了警长及其秘书共用一间办公室所带来的不便。
华籍职员宿舍。华捕的住宿条件也较好。中央站的华捕宿舍没有煤气
照明。东站的华捕所有人共用一间房间，这带来了一定的不便，因为
当休班的巡捕需要休息时，若一队巡捕被叫醒去执勤，或另一队巡捕
下班后进入房间，就会打扰休班巡捕的休息。如果将该房间用砖或木
隔断分成相等的三部分，从而为三个分队形成三个房间，并在需建造
的游廊上开设出入口，这种不便即可消除。
服装、装备、武器。服装状况良好，库存足以供欧籍巡捕在1895年期
间使用。随后的检查

page_data.en:
7.
would foresee the necessities for 1896 & order for the useful
time. The equipment & arms are in a good state and
sufficient. After the next target practice of the European
constables, there would perhaps be need to make up an
indent for cartridges to maintain the supply to the
necessary quantity.
Duty of the Constables. The staff in general merits
praise for the attention & zeal shown in their duty.
(Excepting some exceptions, the conduct of the Sergeants
& Constables is good & the failure of duty are rare.
The momentary reduction in the staff does not at all
diminish the zeal of the Constables, who generally show
good-will in ordinary times & in cases of exceptional
Duty, such as at fires, riots, etc. which often happen.
Health of the Personnel. The sanitary state is good in
general; a sergeant & 10 constables were treated in
the General Hospital in the course of the year, for
migraine sickness; only one European constable
is still in Hospital for dysentery, from which it
appears he had the germ before his entrance in the
"Guard last May". Nine native constables have
been 225 days in the Hospital of Shanhaig Road;
& three are more actually under treatment.
I have the honour to be,
(Sd.) Chairman.
The Councillors,
Your most respectful servant
Kreider
Superintendent.
page_data.zh:
7.
将预估1896年的需求，并在适当时机订购。装备和武器状况良好且
充足。在欧籍巡捕下一次射击训练后，可能需要申请补充弹药，以
维持必要的储备量。
巡捕职责。全体职员在履行职责时表现出的关注和热情值得称赞。
（除个别例外，警长和巡捕的行为良好，失职情况罕见。
人员的暂时减少丝毫没有降低巡捕的热情，他们通常在平时以及
在火灾、骚乱等经常发生的特殊勤务情况下表现出良好的意愿。
人员健康状况。整体卫生状况良好；年内有一名警长和10名巡捕
因偏头痛在总医院接受治疗；仅有一名欧籍巡捕仍因痢疾住院，
看来他在去年五月加入“巡捕房”之前就已感染病菌。九名华捕在
山海关路医院住院共计225天；另有三人目前仍在接受治疗。
谨致，
（签名）主席。
各位董事，
您最恭敬的仆人
Kreider
警长。

Glenroy Tambaroora
N.S.W. Australia
Aug; 10th 1895
To
The Inspector General of
Police Shanghai China
Dear Sir
I take the liberty of
writing to you, as I have been
writing to my brother whose last
address to me was, "Thomas
Mellows Municipal Police
Hongkew St. Shanghai"
without receiving any reply, & we
are afraid he got mixed up in
the late War China & Japan.
Kindly let me know if he is still
in the Police & what address, but
if not kindly make inquiries so
as in any case to give me news of
him, I feel sure you will do your
best, as we are very anxious about
our Brother. Tom.

A 247.
格伦罗伊，坦巴鲁拉（Glenroy Tambaroora）
新南威尔士州，澳大利亚
1895年8月10日

致
中国上海
警务总监

尊敬的先生：

冒昧致函阁下，因我曾写信给我的兄弟，他留给我的最后地址是“托马斯·梅洛斯（Thomas Mellows），上海虹口街工部局警务处”，但一直未收到回音。我们担心他卷入了近期中日战争。恳请告知他是否仍在警队任职及其现址；若不在，也请代为查询，以便在任何情况下都能向我提供关于他的消息。我相信阁下会尽力相助，因为我们非常担忧我们的兄弟汤姆。

I remain Your

reply. W. H. Mellows

THE strike of the washermen, which
might easily become a matter of great
annoyance to the foreign residents,
especially now with the warm weather
coming on, is an instance of the pro-
voked state of blackmailing among the
particular class of blackguards who, while
they are not the approved of a
certain section of the community, are yet
allowed to exist. The case was tried in
the International Mixed Court, and
judgment was given which their talents for
legislation might be very suitably exer-
cised. The cause of the strike is
ostensibly the high price of rice, which
the strikers allege necessitates an in-
crease of wages; but if this be the case
the remedy lies, not in the "squeezing"
of the foreign community, but in the
punishment of the Chinese ring who, in
a year of plenty like the present, have
actually sent all native foodstuffs up to
famine prices for their own selfish ends.
If this infamous disposition to strike,
which is being manifested by all classes
of native workpeople, is not speedily
checked with a strong hand, industry of
every kind will be virtually paralysed
in these Settlements. The mill-hands
are going on in the right way
to shut up all the cotton mills,
filatures and factories in the place
with their shameless and exorbitant
demands for unheard of wages, which the
proprietors might as well close up their
establishments at once, as attempt to
satisfy. In this greedy spirit, we fear, the
real cause of most of China's miseries
and troubles is to be sought. It
obstructs all progress, strangles every
development and is responsible for more
want, starvation and national humiliation
than all the alien wars and inroads re-
corded in Chinese history. Greed is the
keynote of the Chinese character. It is
the national vice, and until the people
themselves learn to curb it, we fear the
work of legions of reformers will be
futile in this hopeless country. All for-
eigners should make the most deter-
mined stand before this latest develop-
ment of an insatiate spirit, and if the
Municipal Council can devise a means of
combating the extortionate washmen
and the scoundrelly mill-hands who are
threatening to annihilate the cotton-trade,
they will have achieved a work that
will do much to compensate for a good
many mistakes in other directions.

洗衣工的罢工，在天气渐热之际，极易成为令外侨居民极为烦恼之事，这一事件反映了特定阶层流氓无赖中猖獗的勒索状态。这些人虽不为社会某一部分人所认可，却被允许存在。此案已在国际混合法庭审理，并作出了判决，他们的立法才能或许可以得到更适宜的施展。罢工的表面原因是米价高涨，罢工者声称这 necessitates（需要）增加工资；但如果情况确实如此，补救之道不在于“压榨”外侨社区，而在于惩罚那些华人帮派，他们在像今年这样的丰年，竟为了自私的目的将本土食品价格推高至饥荒水平。如果这种在所有阶层华人工人中显现出来的可恶罢工倾向不迅速以强力加以遏制，租界内的各类产业实际上将陷入瘫痪。纱厂工人正以一种正确的方式，通过其无耻且过分的、要求闻所未闻的高工资的行为，试图关闭此地所有的棉纺厂、缫丝厂和工厂。业主们与其试图满足这些要求，不如立即关闭他们的机构。在这种贪婪的精神中，我们担心，中国大多数苦难和麻烦的真正根源便在于此。它阻碍一切进步，扼杀所有发展，造成的贫困、饥饿和民族耻辱比中国历史上记载的所有对外战争和入侵还要多。贪婪是中国人的性格基调。这是国民劣根性，除非人民自己学会克制它，否则我们担心，在这个绝望的国家里，无数改革者的工作将是徒劳的。所有外侨都应对这种贪得无厌精神的最新发展采取最坚决的立场，如果工部局董事会能想出办法来对付那些敲诈勒索的洗衣工和威胁要摧毁棉花贸易的无赖纱厂工人，他们将完成一项足以弥补其他方面许多错误的工作。

I beg, in accordance with your instructions, to Submit

This institution is situated in the Seiga Village
and is capable of accommodating over two hundred persons.
The building is arranged in three squares, in the first of
which, are the manager's and accountants rooms, the
dispensary, a vaccination office, a school room and two
store-rooms. In the second and third, are big wards,
forty four in number. Each contains forty beds, nearly all
of which are occupied. Most of the inmates are under
treatment for opium smoking. A small proportion are
destitutes. Seventy five beggars are amongst the
number, and not being altogether unfit for work, they
are employed along with the others in making match
boxes.

Three wards are reserved for sick beggars, and in one of
these wards three sick men were lying on the floor, which
was in a most filthy condition - With this exception
the wards were fairly clean.

A separate building at the back, is reserved for females.
It is in charge of a matron, is divided into wards,
and has a dispensary of its own. At present there
are forty inmates, all of whom have been sent by
the Mixed Court Magistrate. The majority are young
girls. Some have figured in Court, in cases
of ill treatment, others have been rescued from
houses of ill fame.

The female wards are supported by the Mr. G. Hart
who periodically pays the account as they are presented.
The other wards are kept up by voluntary contributions
from shopkeepers and others in the City and
the Settlements.

三间病房专门用于收治患病乞丐，其中一间病房里有三名病人躺在地板上，地面状况极其肮脏——除这一例外，病房相当清洁。

NOTICE.
By the present notice I make known to all Portuguese
subjects in China, that the present intervention of the Powers in the
Empire being only against the Boxers and other anti- foreigners, it
does not change in any way the existent regimen of the Treaties.
Therefore, in order to prevent the sale of arms and ammunitions to
our enemies. I gave full power to the Municipal Police to confiscate,
without need of any formality, the contraband goods which any Portuguese
subject might have landed or stored without special permission
from the competent representative of H. M. F. M's. any violation of
this rule should fall under the penalty of the art. 156 of the
penal Portuguese code - H. M. F. M. s. Shanghai, 23rd. July, 1900.
page_data.zh:
通告。
借此通告，我向在中国的所有葡萄牙
臣民宣布，目前列强在
帝国的干预仅针对义和团及其他反外国人势力，
这在任何方面都不会改变现存的条约体制。
因此，为了防止向我们的敌人出售武器和弹药。
我授予公共租界警务处全权，无需任何手续，
没收任何葡萄牙臣民未经葡萄牙国王陛下代表特别许可
而卸货或储存的违禁品。任何违反此规定的行为
将受到葡萄牙刑法典第156条的处罚 - 葡萄牙国王陛下。上海，1900年7月23日。

COPY

H. M. F. M's. Consul General
Shanghai, 23rd. July, 1900.

Sir,

As the present intervention of the Powers in China is
only to maintain peace and against the Boxers or those anti -
forsign rebels the Consuls and Foreigners continue to live under
the protection of the Treaties, specially in the southern and
central provinces.

According to the said Treaties all munitions and other
implements of war are contraband goods which should be confiscated
where they will appear, if landed or stored in China, without
valuable permit of Chinese Authorities and representatives of the
Powers who cannot allow that such articles be used against them.

Therefore I give the Municipal Police by the enclosed
notice full power to without need of any warrant confiscate
all contraband goods landed or stored by any Portuguese subject
without a valuable permit.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant
(sd.) J. M. T. Valdez.
Consul General for Portugal

E. A. Hewett Esq.
Chairman.

副本

葡萄牙国王陛下总领事
上海，1900年7月23日。

先生，

鉴于目前列强在中国的干预仅
是为了维持和平并针对义和团或那些反
外国叛乱者，领事和外国人继续生活在
条约的保护之下，特别是在南部和
中部省份。

根据上述条约，所有弹药和其他
战争工具均为违禁品，若在中国卸货或储存
而未获得中国政府当局及列强代表的
有效许可（列强代表不能允许此类物品被用于对抗他们），
一经发现即应予以没收。

因此，我通过随附的通告授予公共租界警务处
全权，无需任何搜查令，即可没收任何葡萄牙臣民
在无有效许可情况下卸货或储存的所有违禁品。

我很荣幸成为，
先生，
您顺从的仆人
(签名) J. M. T. Valdez.
葡萄牙总领事

E. A. Hewett 先生
主席
